children: UAE-based Ohana Development has broken ground on its 15 billion UAE dirhams ($4.08 billion) Manchester City Yas Residences by Ohana in Abu Dhabi.
The gated waterfront community, located on Yas Canal adjacent to Yas Island, spans 1.67 million square metres (sqm) and will comprise more than 2,000 residences, the developer said.
The project will be delivered in phases by 2029, the statement added,
In March, Zawya Projects had reported that the self-funded project will be delivered in two phases. The report said the main contract was awarded to Ohana’s in-house contracting arm.
The development, described as Manchester City's first branded residential project globally, was officially launched in February 2026.

The project includes four- and five-bedroom standalone villas, twin villas and townhouses, as well as maisonettes, waterfront penthouses and apartments with more than 55 percent of the masterplan allocated to landscaped gardens and green spaces.
The development will feature a Manchester City training academy, including football pitches and tactical and fitness training areas.
Other planned facilities include a marina sports club and facilities for kayaking, paddleboarding and sailing, as well as fitness centres, spas, swimming pools and recovery facilities.
The project was officially launched in February 2025, with standalone villas priced at an average $1.9 million.

title: Ohana breaks ground on $4.08bln Manchester City-branded residential project in Abu Dhabi
